claim.allocation: task efficiency under shared relative plan budget

adapter.eligible_layers: ordered runtime list; never restrict by observed efficiency
adapter.anchor_layer: native_z_layer, need not belong to eligible set
adapter.lookup: native subject lookup per rewrite and KL row
adapter.canonical_target: post-injection block output from terminal evaluated virtual forward
adapter.writer_local_additive_mapping: must qualify correspondence from native weight update output to injection space, else UNSUPPORTED_ADAPTER
adapter.native_paths: runtime/source hash bound; no historical path assumptions

fit.anchors: positive finite fixed canonical entry block norms a_lr and a_star_r
fit.teacher: batch entry full-vocabulary native KL distribution
fit.anchor_dtype: native activation/norm reduction dtype once at entry; current profile FP32; do not recompute norms in FP64

optimizer.name: EfficiencyAdam
optimizer.mathematical_status: finite-step heuristic; not a certified constrained optimizer
optimizer.initialize: u=M=V=s=0 and independent request update counter=0
optimizer.gradient: g_F=gradient(F_r,u_r); g_J=g_F+beta_r*e; e=u/norm(u) if nonzero else zero
optimizer.model_backwards: one F backward only for each updated candidate
optimizer.request_scaling: optimizer uses each raw grad J_r; sum request losses or undo mean scaling exactly once
optimizer.moment_scope: per request per layer per coordinate; independent step counter per request
optimizer.projection: exact Euclidean group-L1 ball; FP64 compute then FP32 plan storage
optimizer.projection_threshold: tau_proj; distinct from objective multiplier mu
optimizer.stop: per-request J_r < stop_threshold before backward; includes candidate0
optimizer.terminal: last evaluated finite candidate, never best evaluation-selected candidate
optimizer.terminal_gradient: null with NO_BACKWARD_TERMINAL; no extra diagnostic backward
optimizer.stopped_requests: freeze u/moments/counter; retain targets and full writer columns
optimizer.failure: nonfinite/invalid shape or source parity violation prevents commit; no silent fallback

diagnostics.terminal_KKT: NOT_EVALUATED_NO_BACKWARD; previous candidate retains own ID
diagnostics.plan_share: norm(u_l)/sum(norm(u)); zero vector plus NO_PLANNED_EDIT if total0
diagnostics.realized_share: norm(U_applied_l*k_canonical_l)/a_lr normalized over l; U_applied=actual stored weight difference after native orientation; not an additive output decomposition
diagnostics.required: raw norms, candidate IDs, task/norm/total gradients, gamma, tau_proj, mu_hat, full directional KKT, budget usage, request termination, R/delta/inherited split, direct mean/canonical/context effects
diagnostics.zero_realized_total: realized share null with ZERO_REALIZED_TOTAL; planned share separately zero vector with NO_PLANNED_EDIT

write.refresh: both actual current K_l and canonical current block h_l after all lower writes and before this layer write
write.history: recapture native final-model keys after every layer write completed; append final Gram once per occurrence and layer
write.cast: native FP64 solve/update then native FP32 cast/add orientation
write.actual_fp32_increment_telemetry: record cast/add effective update separate from FP64 ideal when measured
write.atomicity: preflight whole batch; rollback all this-batch weights and history on write/history failure; no partial scientific endpoint

single_layer_reduction.parity_scope: loss, transformed Adam arithmetic and ball projection; numerical qualification required

technical_tolerances.cpu_fp64_algebra: atol1e-10 except documented solver finite-difference comparisons
technical_tolerances.FP32_gradient: relative norm <=2e-3; if reference norm<=1e-8 then max abs <=1e-6
technical_tolerances.failing_tolerance_policy: technical failure; no silent jitter, coefficient change, candidate count change or success-only denominator

evaluation.strict_ACC: teacher forced every desired target token argmax matches; not free generation exact match
evaluation.runtime_comparison: same input/order/model/evaluator/hardware policy; historical mismatched data descriptive only
